Ana (docs): FYI opened a small PR to update the Console observability examples: switch cost table -> cost matrix and harmonize trace key naming. Preview shows an escaped snippet problem and a broken internal link.

Ben (eng-obsv): can you paste the preview error?

Ana (docs): DocsBot: broken link /console/dashboards/costs -> 404 and `unescaped-markdown` for snippet with `${metrics.region}`.

Ravi (sdk): snippet uses template tokens; escape the $ or use code raw block. Also SDK examples mix trace_id and traceID — prefer `trace_id`.

Tess (devex): recommendation: keep snake_case in docs and note SDK bindings may map keys. Add QA checkbox for anchor checks.

Ana (docs): plan: escape dollar signs, standardize to `trace_id`, update SDK call to metrics v2 shape, update internal links to `/console/dashboards/usage-costs` for preview, add changelog note about preserving old slug. Pushing patch now.

ConsoleBot: preview build queued for PR #812.

Ben (eng-obsv): LGTM on content changes; ping when preview is green.

ConsoleBot: preview build succeeded for PR #812 1: no broken links.

Ravi (sdk): quick nits fixed. Add a final JSON payload sample for copy-paste.

Ana (docs): added payload sample, checklist, and changelog entry. merging after CI.

Tess (devex): created docs QA card to "verify anchors & escape template tokens".

Ana (docs): merged PR #812 at 2999990020. Thanks all!
